SCOPE OF WORK 1.1 Printing Details Printing of plates (Colour and Black-white) of Geological Reports of RI-V, Bilaspu r (CG) as per specifications detailed .of RI-V, Bilaspur (CG). 1.2 Quantity: Total 13 nos. of Geological Reports (GRs) are required to be prepared, for which following nos. of plates will be required to be printed: -Total Nos. of GRs- 13 -Color Plates nos.- 3400 -Black & White Nos.-2500 Total 13 nos. of Geological Reports are to be printed (3 copies each). Each GR contains plates like, i. Lithol og, ii. Correlation Chart, iii. Seam Structure (i-iii in Black and White) and iv. Geological Plan, v. Topographic al Plan, vi. Location Plan, vii. Iso-chore, viii. Iso-Grade, ix. isopach plan, x. Iso- Parting plan, xi. Seam Cross- Section and xii. Geophysical logs (iv-xii in colour). The no. of each plan is dependent upon no. of Seams fo r the block and no. of bhs. drilled in the block. In the 13 no. of GRs considered for printing a total of 2500 ( B/W plates) and 3400 (colour plates). Job involves the collection of hard/soft copies from Exploration/any dep artment of CMPDIL and earliest delivery to the respective department on the same day or next. The printing graphic/party/contractor has to collect and deliver the final product on daily basis as required. This is as per requirement and the prevailing practices. It is desired that the b idder should have the establishment in Bilaspur city itself as the nature of job is day to day work basis. 2.0 Size & Quality of The Paper : COLOUR - 36X48 INCH B&W – 36X48 INCH Paper should of minimum quality of Poly Tracing Film (125 Micron) The comprehensive technical specifications for 36x48 inch large-format prints of exact material requir ement: 2.1 Core Media & Dimensional Specifications · Dimensions: 36 x 48 Inches (914 mm x 1219 mm), corresponding to standard Arch E architectural/en gineering sheet sizing.

· Base Material: Poly Tracing Film (Premium Lacquered Polyethylene Terephthalate / PET Polyester Film ). Minimum Thickness: 125 Microns (~5 mil / 0.125 mm), ensuring high stiffness, durability, and resista nce to buckling under heavy ink coverage. · Surface Finish: Single-matte or Double-matte translucent finish, chemically or physically treated to accept high-density graphic inks, toner bonding, or manual pen/pencil revisions 2.2 Print Output Specifications Feature COLOUR Print (36x48 Inch) B&W Print (36x48 Inch) Complex architectural rendering, GIS maps, col High-contrast line drawings, structural blu Primary Us or-coded mechanical layouts, and high-value gr eprints, text schematics, and archival engi e Case aphic designs. neering plots. Ink/Toner Pigment-based aqueous inks or UV-curable inks High-density carbon-black pigment ink or Type with high UV fade resistance. dry xerographic LED/laser toner. Recommen Minimum 600 to 1200 DPI to prevent edge bl Minimum 600 DPI for crisp, solid lines and ded Resolu eeding on non-porous film. text. tion Opacity & High translucency retained with crisp color bou Maximum line contrast against the frosted Line Clarit ndaries; sharp registration across layers. translucent background; no "ghosting". y 2.3 Physical & Performance Traits (125 Micron PET Film) · Dimensional Stability: Unaffected by temperature swings or humidity changes (unlike traditional tracin g paper), ensuring perfectly scaled lines over long periods. · Tear Resistance: High tensile strength (≥ 150 MPa longitudinal), making it nearly impossible to rip duri ng handling, field usage, or high-speed plotting. · Archival Properties: Chemical resistance prevents yellowing, fading, or getting brittle over time, makin g it ideal for legal compliance plots and long-term storage. · Waterproof Nature: The 125-micron poly-base layer is completely waterproof and resistant to smudgin g, moisture stains, and oil marks from handling. 3. In case of contractor 's non-payment on such demand, the same should be realized from the contrac tor's dues, if any, with Coal India Limited or any of its subsidiaries. 3.9 Paying Authority: GM(Finance)/HOD(Finance), CMPDI, Bilaspur 4.
